name: moonbase
description: Deploy and run AI-built apps on moonbase: hosting, PostgreSQL, domains, rollbacks, analytics.

interface.longDescription: Put an app you built with AI online and keep running it from the chat: deploy, read why a deploy failed, connect a custom domain, set environment variables, roll back to an earlier version, invite teammates and read visitor stats. moonbase can create a managed PostgreSQL database for the app. You need a moonbase account and sign in to it in the browser; no API key is used. Some tools are available only on accounts or projects where moonbase has switched them on.
defaultPrompt: Put this app online with moonbase.
Why did my last moonbase deploy fail?
Connect my own domain to my moonbase app.
